notes.title: DEVBLOG #1
notes.content:
[h1]CONGRATULATION[/h1]

The first week of the beta test is coming to end. We thank all participants and provide a list of changes

[h1]UPDATES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added weapon upgrade system
[*]Fixed bug - desynchronization of doors
[*]Updated character editor
[*]Balance weapons
[*]Balance experience system
[/list]

[h1]ALSO[/h1]
Release is comming and we will begin to implement your ideas in the game. Don't forget that you can write to us not only at the mail but also in community discussions. There you can discuss your idea with other players.
